style.styleTitle: Homcom 7ft Pencil Artificial Christmas Tree With Colourful Led Lights And Steel Base
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Christmases made simple, forever more. This HOMCOM artificial prelit Christmas tree is a mess-free, must-have addition to the magical season ahead. Made from flame-retardant plastic, it is safe for use in your home. The beauty of a traditional tree, without the mess and one-season lifespan - what s not to like? Bare design to add you decorations, however does come with LED lights to help save with the set up.</p><ul><li>7.5ft tall -great for medium and large rooms;</li><li>Comes with colourful LED lights -helps with the set up;</li><li>Flame retardant branches for safety: won t catch on fire. Do not leave close to naked flames to safety;</li><li>Steel base included to stand steady;</li><li>For indoor use ONLY;</li><li>Colour: Green;</li><li>Light Colour: Multi-Coloured;</li><li>Material: Plastic, Steel;</li><li></li><li>Cord Length: 2.7m;</li><li>Tip Count: 529;</li><li>Light Count: 200(LED);</li><li>Input: 220V-240V, 50-60Hz;</li><li>Output: 31V, 116mA, 3.6W;</li><li>Item Label: 830-755V72GN;</li></ul><p>Note: ;</p><p>Only for indoor use, not for outdoor;</p><p>In order to get a full appearance, please spread out all individual tips to get the best possible look from the tree, suggest you take 30-45 minutes to shape the tree.</p>
